name: skill-refine-allowlist
//: The refine-allowlist agent skill (refine-allowlist/, installed by users with `gh skill install`) and its install check (verify-skill-install.sh: install via gh, validate the frontmatter, drive the CLI contract the skill relies on). Out of the gate — it needs the gh skill preview command — and run by .github/workflows/skill-install.yml through `just verify-skill`. This project.json lives beside, not inside, the skill directory so an install never ships it.
